snippet.title: R2R - Game atmosphere (trailer) | Unreal engine
snippet.description:
In 2045, in the darkness of the nuclear explosion that devastated Eastern Europe, where technology has become a key weapon, began a new war for intellectual resources, two once-peaceful nations have been drawn into a confrontation over the mental resources of the human mind.

In the chaos, an experimental neural network has been created. Its core is based on the mind of a murderous dictator who seeks immortality to maintain his power at all costs and enslave the population by extracting neural matter from human brains.

We find ourselves at the epicenter of this conflict, where artificial intelligence poses a threat against humanity.
